sentences.text: Hello everyone, welcome back to the English for everyday life podcast. I'm
Emilie and today we're going to talk about how to speak English at the gym.
Whether you're a beginner at the gym or you've been going for a while, it's

talking to gym staff or asking for help. In today's episode, I'll guide you

it's important to follow some basic rules so everyone can have a great experience. Here are
a few things to keep in mind. Key gym etiquette tips. Wipe down machines. After using a machine,

don't use the machine for too long. Respect other space. If someone is using a machine,
